about.description: I am a frontend developer with over 4 years of experience, specialized in Angular, Ionic, and WordPress. I am passionate about creating functional, accessible, and simple interfaces, combining development and design. I consider myself responsible, self-taught, and oriented toward continuous learning. I am currently deepening my knowledge of React and looking for new challenges to continue growing professionally.

experience.description-1: Design and development of interfaces using Angular and Ionic, creating fast and scalable experiences. Participation in UX/UI design, performance optimization, and development of solutions aligned with the agribusiness domain.
experience.description-2: Web interface development with Angular, flow layout, creation of SEO-friendly landing pages, and accessibility optimization.
experience.description-3: Student mentoring, project reviews, technical feedback, and learning guidance in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
experience.description-4: Co-founder of a design studio, working on branding, visual identity, and the development of complete digital assets.

studies.description-1: Zoneless architecture, Signals, Bindings, SSR, SSG, SEO, Testing, i18n, TanStack, Monorepos, NPM, custom packages, and more.
studies.description-2: Full Stack programming course covering HTML, CSS, React, JavaScript, databases, and APIs.
studies.description-3: JavaScript course focused on jQuery libraries and development techniques for modern applications using AJAX.
studies.description-4: Web Development course covering HTML, CSS, SCSS, GitHub, and Bootstrap.
studies.description-5: Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design. Training in visual communication, editorial design, visual identity, typography, branding, composition, color theory, digital design, and creative processes applied to graphic and digital media.

landing.title: Landing Page Design & Development
landing.subtitle: Frontend Developer · UI Implementer
landing.description: HTML5, SCSS, JavaScript/Framework, responsive design. I implemented the complete visual and functional structure of the landing page, developing key sections such as header, benefits, call-to-action areas, and footer. I built a fully responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop, applying CSS/SCSS best practices to ensure a scalable and maintainable interface. I also integrated subtle animations to enhance user experience and optimized performance to deliver a fast and lightweight website, working from a previously defined design.

rrss.title: Social Media Design
rrss.subtitle: Social Media · Content · Figma
rrss.description: I designed a series of Instagram posts in Figma, creating visual content for the feed focused on institutional communication, product launches, and informational content. I worked on visual identity, composition, typography, and color usage to achieve a cohesive, modern feed aligned with the brand, presented in an interactive profile mockup.

canva.title: Design – Animation
canva.subtitle: Canva
canva.description: I developed the visual structure, composition balance, color selection, and motion timing to create a dynamic piece with smooth and engaging transitions.
